prediction.raw: A very considerate gesture! I think it's <1>. Lice can easily transfer from one person's hair to another through shared personal items like hair brushes. By lending your hair brush to your sister, you're increasing the risk of her getting lice as well. It's generally a good idea to use separate hair brushes or clean and disinfect the brush thoroughly before sharing it with someone else.
